items.title_zh: X 发帖 @laurogeitabat：问：“达到300场比赛是你的目标吗？” Oscar：“不一定。对我来说，我在那些比赛中取得的成就才是更重要的，但赛季越来越长，所以达到300场需要的年数更少。能跑那么多场比赛非常了不起，如果我能做到那会很酷。”
items.summary: Q: "is reaching 300 races a goal for you?" oscar: "not necessarily. for me what i achieve in those races is the bigger thing, but the seasons are getting longer so it takes less years to get to 300. it's very impressive to do that many races, if i can do that it'd be very cool." https://t.co/7b2LHTHdcI
